blocks.text: **Alignment with Wesgro's plan.** Gate 1 falls in the fourth year of Wesgro's FY26 to FY30 plan, in time to shape the next one. The gate paper maps the initiatives' outputs to the plan's six targets (Wesgro, Strategic Plan 2025/26 to 2029/30, p20). The activity targets roughly hold today's pace, while the arrivals target sits above every modelled path to 2030 (section 1.1). The paper therefore states which activity targets the action plan would raise, and tests the arrivals target against seats and routes.

edits.reason: Assessment 5, Chapter 4, Governance (High) and 6, first finding: the plan's activity targets roughly hold today's pace while its arrivals target is 2.6 to 3.3 times the base-case gain (decisions, arrivals metric period). Section 1.1 names Gate 1 as the point for this mapping. Review: the initiative-to-indicator mapping is left to the Gate 1 row (edit on ch4/07_governance[7]); 'today's pace' points to section 1.1.
